rationale: Price is at 91.8% of today's range and within 0.83% of the session high after a large gap-up move, with the last five 1-minute candles showing tight, low-volume consolidation that lacks a clear directional catalyst. Entering long here risks buying near exhaustion with limited upside to the high and a poor risk/reward ratio, while a short against a strong uptrend with price above VWAP and the 9-EMA offers no structural breakdown signal. The elevated VIXY reading adds macro uncertainty, making the risk/reward unattractive in either direction at this moment.
